buffers.gemv_layout: one 1KiB SRF partitioned into fragment views

input_staging_dram.storage: DRAM array; excluded from GEMV SRAM capacity
input_staging_dram.layout: [fragment//bank_count][token][lane16] BF16 per bank; reused between operators

buffers.input_fill_policy: Entire operator GPU input -> source-bank DRAM -> source-bank SRF -> same-rank SRF broadcast
buffers.input_compute_order: Fill all valid views; consume the entire SRF batch before any overwrite

attention.coefficient_positions: Actual model position IDs; cache token indices are not assumed equal to positions
attention.coefficient_lifetime: Reusable work region per active bank; table reused across layers/steps while positions agree
attention.projection_numeric_contract: FP32 accumulation followed by BF16 rounding before local spill and RoPE
attention.numeric_claim: Timing/traffic model; no claim of bitwise PyTorch or JAX equivalence
attention.q_residency: Local8 Q columns in DRAM; all16 queries hold slot0 of the shared bank GEMV pair until explicit release
attention.k_residency: 484 prefix columns then8 suffix and4 zero-padding columns in work region
attention.qk_loop_order: Fill all16 Q columns once, then scan496 local K columns once
attention.score_ownership: Bank->BG->rank reduction completes256feature dot; ranks produce different K tokens, not partial scores

value.execution: Whole 1KiB SRF batches; V token parity and PV full-query rank-partial outputs

spill.conversion: FP32 accumulator -> BF16; gather eight suffix values into KV lanes4..11
spill.timing: native LOCALRD32 then LOCALWR32; cast/gather included in modeled local path

value.cache_writeback: bank-local RMW; no GPU V export/scatter
